sources.name: Planning Data adopted LBBD Local Plan
sources.fact: adopted plan is current local statutory plan evidence; historic OAPF proposals cannot override it

examples: Current adopted OA 44000-home/29000-job potential differs from older OAPF 26500/16000 and draft 2050 38000/31400; vintages must remain separate
Industria is a specific delivered/dated industrial-intensification example, not proof every nearby parcel can intensify
Historic East Plus 6500-job potential is proposal-era evidence, not current job count
SIL release requires policy/site-specific evidence and cannot be inferred from proximity
Housing and industrial intensification can conflict and must be evaluated through current adopted policy
Historic Gateways estimates must not be treated as completed housing
Employment capacity is strategic/site context, not parcel valuation or guaranteed jobs
No industrial-growth factor can promote a parcel without current exact land-use and geometry evidence
